_comment: SINGLE SOURCE OF TRUTH for models. sync-models.ps1 generates each -cc variant from this (Ollama's
default context is far too small for the agent loop, so every model needs num_ctx raised);
use-model.ps1 reads the aliases; install.ps1 calls sync; uninstall.ps1 -Full removes these names;
dad-doctor.ps1 reports what is present. To add a model: append one entry here. That is the whole job.
approxVramGb is the Q4-ish footprint - on 16 GB, <=15 runs on the GPU and bigger offloads to RAM.
autoPull: pulled automatically by sync/install. Others are built only if you already pulled the base.
_fitComment: approxVramGb is WEIGHTS ONLY. The KV cache is extra and scales with numCtx: kvCacheGbAt64k is a
rough estimate for 64K with OLLAMA_KV_CACHE_TYPE=q8_0 (a real figure depends on layers/kv-heads).
Fit = approxVramGb + kv vs assumeVramGb. Within ~1 GB of the limit is BORDERLINE: it usually runs,
but expect partial offload and variable speed. Override per model with kvGb if you measure a real one.
_cloudComment: install.ps1 -Cloud wires Claude Code at Anthropic's API instead of Ollama: each alias resolves to its 'cloud' id below, ANTHROPIC_SMALL_FAST_MODEL becomes cloudSmallFast, and the base-URL redirect is dropped (its absence IS the mode - use-model and dad-doctor read it back).

models.name: devstral-cc
models.role: Devstral Small 24B dense - fast GPU-resident coding, /proto, quick /spec. No CJK drift.

models.name: qwen3-coder-30b-cc
models.role: Qwen3-Coder 30B-A3B MoE - recommended everyday /build: strong tools, mostly GPU-resident.

models.name: gpt-oss-20b-cc
models.role: gpt-oss-20b MoE (~A3.6B) - THE PLANNER: /design, /stories, /audit. Most literal instruction-follower; smallest VRAM footprint of the reasoners.

models.name: gemma4-cc
models.role: Gemma 4 ~26B DENSE generalist - optional. Dense AND over the VRAM budget at 64K, so it partially offloads: slower than the MoE options. Prefer oss for planning.

models.name: qwen3-coder-next-cc
models.role: Qwen3-Coder-Next 80B-A3B - most capable: /design contracts, /taskmap, hardest /build. Offloads to RAM (slow).

models.name: qwen3-14b-cc
models.role: Dense 14B - quickest, fully on GPU: light edits.
